dedupe_keys.name: mtress local energy supply optimisation template

description: MTRESS is a model template for optimising energy supply in buildings, neighbourhoods and industrial properties. The German Aerospace Center README says it uses oemof.solph and includes predefined electricity, heat and gas components such as photovoltaics, wind, grid connection and thermal technologies. Users define local demands, technology choices, capacities and prices; outputs are feasible energy-system configurations and operating schedules under the chosen objective. Geographic coverage is user-defined and can be any site for which input data exist. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that optimisation can only compare the equipment and constraints encoded by the user; permits, installation space and real network conditions may need extra modelling. MTRESS can test district-energy and building electrification scenarios. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model also optimises energy systems but has a different template and scale. No scenario inputs or solver package were downloaded.
inputs: Local demand, technology, costs and constraints
